stories.title: Observed contract and shared interfaces
stories.scope_and_acceptance: Observe V1 workspace and board entry, then map the historical browser inventory to a fresh screenshot/state ledger. Record matching fixture recipes and remaining feature-specific observations. Freeze minimal shared TS interfaces, typed fixture stubs, component slots, route/state ownership, operation outcome semantics and module ownership so R02/R03 compile independently. Architect validates this boundary. Identify reusable V2 operations with documented V2 provenance. No V1 source inspection.

stories.title: Fresh workspace entry
stories.scope_and_acceptance: Implement fresh TS root/workspace shell, board discovery/selection and read-only workspace status against the frozen interfaces. Match V1 populated, empty, loading and unavailable workspace appearance and behavior. Own workspace files only. integrate the separate board slot through its contract.

stories.title: Fresh selected-board composition
stories.scope_and_acceptance: Implement the independent board component against R01 fixture stubs and slots. Match V1 header, selected-board presentation, lane order/width, permission captions, card density, priority/ticket/title/comment indicators, scrolling and empty board. The Lead composes it with R02 for the T2 checkpoint.

stories.title: Workspace navigation controls
stories.scope_and_acceptance: Match V1 pin/unpin and pointer/keyboard pin order, board search, sidebar resize/collapse and current attention/recency. Verify persistence, exact placement, focus and feedback. Exercise a failed pin save with safe readback and preserved last-confirmed order.

stories.title: Board filtering and completed visibility
stories.scope_and_acceptance: Match V1 in-place title/ticket/content search, result counts and recent/older Completed toggle. Compare exact visible membership, empty results, clearing, focus and scrolling with matching data.

stories.title: Read-only card drawer
stories.scope_and_acceptance: Match V1 drawer opening/closing, sizing, focus return, identity/priority/approval/owner/prose, hierarchy navigation, comment preview and audit presentation. Demonstrate formatted prose, ticket links, archived linked work and long-content scrolling. Supply fixed slots for independent edit/comment/relationship/attachment modules.

stories.title: Drawer field and lifecycle actions
stories.scope_and_acceptance: Match V1 title/description, owner and individual priority editing plus archive/restore entry points. Verify exact text, allowed actions, cancellation, validation, audit and unchanged identity. Exercise stale/lost edit response using the R01 operation contract, preserved draft and authoritative inspection before any retry.

stories.title: Comment composition
stories.scope_and_acceptance: Match V1 comment placement, Enter submission, Shift+Enter newline, attribution and history update. Verify exact text and one committed comment. Exercise a lost response, retained unsent/submitted draft and inspection before retry using the fixed operation contract.

stories.title: Create card dialog
stories.scope_and_acceptance: Match V1 allowed-lane entry and create dialog fields, typed relationship rows, description Enter, validation, cancellation/focus and success navigation. Verify one card with exact fields/links after a lost create response. Reserve the specified attachment slot for R17. implement against R01 contracts without depending on R07.

stories.title: Relationship editing
stories.scope_and_acceptance: Match V1 add/change/remove/follow relationship controls, direction, hierarchy context and invalid choices. Verify endpoint/type/history, preserved drawer placement and safe stale/lost-response inspection. Use R01 operation interfaces independently of field editing.

stories.title: Card movement
stories.scope_and_acceptance: Match V1 dropdown, keyboard and drag/drop movement with destination permissions and disabled/refused feedback. Verify lane/revision/audit, focus and scrolling. Exercise stale refusal and lost-response readback without replaying a committed move.

stories.title: Single-card approval
stories.scope_and_acceptance: Match V1 Human approval control and its keyboard/focus/feedback states. Verify Completed lane, fixed approval comment, Human attribution and receipt. Inject one lost approval response and prove one commit by receipt/state inspection before retry.

stories.title: Lane approval
stories.scope_and_acceptance: Match V1 lane approval control, configured text, confirmation and disabled/pending states. Verify exact membership and atomic approval, custom historical text, Human attribution and safe stale-membership/lost-response handling. Use the existing V2 atomic operation with established provenance.

stories.title: Dependency ordering
stories.scope_and_acceptance: Match V1 dependency-order control, opt-in/disabled state, preview and apply interaction. Verify affected membership, resulting ticket order and stable card identities. Demonstrate stale preview refusal and inspection of a lost apply response.

stories.title: Batch priority
stories.scope_and_acceptance: Match V1 batch priority entry, selected scope, priority choices and feedback. Verify exact affected cards, dependency floor and one batch revision. Demonstrate validation, stale refusal and safe lost-response readback.

stories.title: Existing attachments
stories.scope_and_acceptance: Match V1 attachment list, preview/download, cover select/clear, first-image fallback and detach. Verify bytes, identity, cover and detached history. include broken/unsupported preview. For a lost cover/detach response inspect state before retry.

stories.title: Attachment ingestion and recovery
stories.scope_and_acceptance: Match V1 selection/paste/staging in existing-card and create flows, upload-after-create messaging, cancellation and per-file partial outcomes. Verify stored bytes and one attachment per committed upload. Demonstrate reload recovery, original-file reselection and ambiguous-commit inspection for one partial batch using existing V2 operations.

stories.title: Live status and reconnect
stories.scope_and_acceptance: Match V1 connection/build/last-update indicators, Bot/Human attention/tab cues, background-board changes and reconnect feedback using the R01 state boundary. Demonstrate an external change while a contract-backed draft is open. preserve the draft and last-confirmed state. Verify authoritative state and successful reconnect.

stories.title: History navigation and cached reads
stories.scope_and_acceptance: Match V1 Back/Forward/reload restoration of board/search/drawer/scroll, last-confirmed cache, observed cache-budget/eviction controls and failed-refresh feedback. Use R01 shared state interfaces independently of R18 implementation. Demonstrate retained draft, stale read-only view and correct return to live state.

stories.title: Bounded integrated qualification
stories.scope_and_acceptance: Run the prepared cross-feature parity matrix once on the integrated candidate with equivalent V1/V2 fixtures and viewports. Check workspace entry, one full mutable journey, cross-feature draft/reconnect recovery, keyboard/focus, observed responsive states, strict gates and optimized release assets. Reuse reviewed per-feature evidence and verify V2 API/CLI retention. Record the result and exact candidate. Create separately scoped defect cards for failures. do not include unlimited fixes in this estimate. Epic handoff remains closed until those defects are independently resolved.

earliest_turn_rule: 1 + maximum dependency earliest turn. root stories are turn 1. Turn gates can postpone these earliest opportunities.

integrated_owner_checkpoint.condition: Side-by-side workspace and selected-board entry, navigation and scrolling accepted before broad feature work. Corrections remain in T2 under scoped tickets.
